u-sub-areas.alt: Left: the graph of y = 2x cos(x squared) from x = 0 to the square root of pi/2, about 1.25, with the region under it shaded; its area is 1. Right: the graph of y = cos u from u = 0 to pi/2, with the region under it shaded; its area is also 1. With u = x squared, the x-limits become the u-limits.
